data.name: PageTitle
data.value: Boarding House Operations Web — Manage rooms, tenants and invoices

data.name: HeroTitle
data.value: Run your boarding house with clear, role-based workflows

data.name: HeroDescription
data.value: From property setup and tenant profiles to contracts, utilities and invoices. Manager actions always wait for owner approval; tenants get their own portal; the AI assistant only drafts.

data.name: FeaturesTitle
data.value: Every daily operation in one system

data.name: FeaturesDescription
data.value: Properties, rooms, tenants, contracts, utilities, invoices, incidents, access, vehicles, reports and approvals — in the right scope for each person.

data.name: Feature1Description
data.value: Three-step property setup, Vietnamese address catalog, manager assignment per building; room price or status changes need approval, with a recycle bin.

data.name: Feature2Description
data.value: Profiles, documents, email or QR invites; national IDs are masked for managers. Tenants view rooms, contracts and invoices at /my/room and /my/documents.

data.name: Feature3Description
data.value: Create/edit contracts, tenant signatures, renewals, reminders, deposits and refunds; invoices from locked periodic costs, owner-specific VietQR and proof uploads.

data.name: Feature4Description
data.value: Tenants report incidents with photos; owners approve through a status workflow; role-based KPIs for revenue, debt, rooms, contracts and costs, with Excel exports that omit national IDs.

data.name: Feature5Description
data.value: Gate access with 60s QR, face, device passkey, 6-digit backup code; guest passes and In/Out logs. Vehicles from bikes to cars with plates or QR tags, parking capacity and parking fees billed to invoices.

data.name: Feature6Description
data.value: The AI assistant only drafts 8 task types; suggestions land in a two-tab inbox and need owner approval. 21 manager switches: every manager action enters the owner's approval queue.

data.name: HowStep1Description
data.value: Three steps, Vietnamese address catalog, assign managers per building.

data.name: HowStep2Description
data.value: Owners and managers only see assigned properties; tenants use their own portal.

data.name: HowStep3Description
data.value: Manager actions and AI suggestions wait for owner approval; role-based KPIs at period end.

data.name: RolesDescription
data.value: Owners approve, managers operate assigned properties, tenants use a self-service portal; data stays within the assigned scope.

data.name: Role1Point2
data.value: Approve manager actions and AI suggestions

data.name: Role1Point3
data.value: View revenue, outstanding balances and reports

data.name: Role2Point1
data.value: Update rooms, tenants and meter readings

data.name: Role2Point2
data.value: Submit actions to the approval queue

data.name: Role3Point1
data.value: View rooms, contracts and invoices in the tenant portal

data.name: Role3Point2
data.value: Report incidents with photos and subscribe to services

data.name: Role3Point3
data.value: Open gates with QR, face or passkey

data.name: CtaDescription
data.value: Already have an account? Sign in. Otherwise register as an owner and set up a property in three steps.

data.name: FaqDescription
data.value: A few things to know before you start.

data.name: Faq1Question
data.value: Is my boarding house data safe?

data.name: Faq1Answer
data.value: Access is scoped to each property; national IDs are masked for managers and sensitive actions are audited.

data.name: Faq2Question
data.value: Do tenants need their own account?

data.name: Faq2Answer
data.value: Yes. Tenants sign in to a dedicated portal to view rooms, contracts and invoices, report incidents and subscribe to services.

data.name: Faq3Question
data.value: Does the AI approve or write data by itself?

data.name: Faq3Answer
data.value: No. The AI only drafts and sends suggestions to an inbox; owners must approve before anything is applied.

data.name: Faq4Question
data.value: Can I manage several properties at once?

data.name: Faq4Answer
data.value: Yes. Create each property, assign managers per building and view KPIs per property.

data.name: FooterDescription
data.value: Boarding house operations for owners, managers and tenants.
